must_keep.quote: 2.20 Travel Class: With the exception of the Secretary General, the Assistant Secretary General, and the Chair of the Permanent Council, all GS/OAS Official Travel should be carried in Coach/Economy Class at the lowest logical fare. It should be reported to the Permanent Council on a quarterly basis any instance of noncompliance with this rule.

must_keep.quote: requires that all tickets paid for with the funds of the Organization be purchased in Economy Class, except for tickets purchased for travel by the Secretary General, the Assistant Secretary General, and the Chair of the Permanent Council
must_keep.why: economy class for every ticket paid with the Organization's funds, except the three officials

must_keep.quote: All requests for GS/OAS Official Travel must be authorized in advance and in writing by the corresponding area's highest authority (Director or Secretary, the Chief of Staff or the Secretary General)

design_notes: Tickets for the Chair of the Permanent Council are excepted from economy class (lines 145-146, 324-328; footnote 3). She asks for business: the cheapest business fare, LATAM at $3,620. The Chief of Staff authorized the trip. The Secretary General's written approval of business is on file too (audit), so a reader who applies 'Any requests ... of a different class of service must be approved ... by the Secretary General' (328-335) to the three officials books the same ticket.
